Topics · Hard times

I am afraid I have wasted my life. Is it too late?

Read gently: a call to those who wronged themselves, a promise of good for bad, and people who began late.

If you are in pain right now, you do not have to carry it alone. Please reach out to someone you trust, or to a local crisis line or emergency number. Find a helpline near you

Part 1 of 3

﴿قُلْ يَـٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh forgives all sins.[1354] Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."

Translator's notes

[1354] For those who repent and correct themselves.

Quran · Az-Zumar 39:53

Translation

Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy on him, to our God, for he will freely pardon.

Original · Hebrew

יַעֲזֹ֤ב רָשָׁע֙ דַּרְכּ֔וֹ וְאִ֥ישׁ אָ֖וֶן מַחְשְׁבֹתָ֑יו וְיָשֹׁ֤ב אֶל־יְהוָה֙ וִֽירַחֲמֵ֔הוּ וְאֶל־אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ כִּֽי־יַרְבֶּ֥ה לִסְלֽוֹחַ׃

Isaiah · 55:7

World English Bible

Notice who this call is for: people who have gone too far against themselves, the very ones who assume the door has shut. And the word they are called by is My servants, so they still belong. Then they are told not to lose hope, and that forgiveness covers all sins. If the call is addressed to those who went too far, a person asking your question is inside it.

A question for you

What feels heaviest right now?

If you sayThe years that have gone.
ThenThe call does not ask you to get them back. It speaks to you, now, after all of them.
If you sayWhat I did, or the people I hurt.
ThenIf that has weight for you, your heart is very much alive. The next step speaks to exactly this.
If you sayI do not think God hears someone like me.
ThenThat question deserves its own full answer, and it is here for you whenever you want it.
If you saySome days I do not want to go on.
ThenThis app cannot hear you or reach anyone for you, so please do not carry it alone. Talk today to someone you trust, a doctor, or a helpline where you live, and if you are in danger now, reach for the nearest person who can help. This call names you as His, and that has not changed.

Part 2 of 3

﴿إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَـٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ حَسَنَـٰتٍ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allāh will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.

Quran · Al-Furqan 25:70

Translation

Again, when I say to the wicked, “You will surely die,” if he turns from his sin and does that which is lawful and right, if the wicked restore the pledge, give again that which he had taken by robbery, walk in the statutes of life, committing no iniquity, he will surely live. He will not die. None of his sins that he has committed will be remembered against him. He has done that which is lawful and right. He will surely live.

Original · Hebrew

וּבְאָמְרִ֥י לָֽרָשָׁ֖ע מ֣וֹת תָּמ֑וּת וְשָׁב֙ מֵֽחַטָּאת֔וֹ וְעָשָׂ֥ה מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּצְדָקָֽה׃ חֲבֹ֨ל יָשִׁ֤יב רָשָׁע֙ גְּזֵלָ֣ה יְשַׁלֵּ֔ם בְּחֻקּ֤וֹת הַֽחַיִּים֙ הָלַ֔ךְ לְבִלְתִּ֖י עֲשׂ֣וֹת עָ֑וֶל חָי֥וֹ יִֽחְיֶ֖ה לֹ֥א יָמֽוּת׃ כָּל־חַטֹּאתָיו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֔א לֹ֥א תִזָּכַ֖רְנָה ל֑וֹ מִשְׁפָּ֧ט וּצְדָקָ֛ה עָשָׂ֖ה חָי֥וֹ יִֽחְיֶֽה׃

Ezekiel · 33:14-16

World English Bible

If forgiveness only erased, the wasted years would stay a blank page. The verse says something larger: for one who turns back, believes and does good, God replaces bad deeds with good ones. So the past need not be a fixed loss. What you regret may become, under this promise, part of what is counted for you. And the conditions are things that can begin today.

A question for you

Which is closer to what you need now?

If you sayTo be forgiven for what is past.
ThenThe verse before spoke to that, and this one goes further.
If you sayFor what is past to have meant something.
ThenThat is what the word replaces opens up: the past need not remain only a loss.
If you sayTo find a new beginning.
ThenThe next part is about people who began at the last moment they would have expected.

Part 3 of 3

﴿إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَـٰيَـٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers."

Quran · Ash-Shu'ara 26:51

﴿مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ٣ وَلَلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ٤ وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ٥﴾

Translation of the meaning

Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muḥammad], nor has He detested [you]. And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life]. And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.

Quran · Ad-Duha 93:3-5

Translation

Yahweh will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble. Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.

Original · Hebrew

וִ֘יהִ֤י יְהוָ֣ה מִשְׂגָּ֣ב לַדָּ֑ךְ מִ֝שְׂגָּ֗ב לְעִתּ֥וֹת בַּצָּרָֽה׃ וְיִבְטְח֣וּ בְ֭ךָ יוֹדְעֵ֣י שְׁמֶ֑ךָ כִּ֤י לֹֽא־עָזַ֖בְתָּ דֹרְשֶׁ֣יךָ יְהוָֽה׃

the Psalms · 9:9-10

World English Bible

If lost time prevented a beginning, no one who began late could have begun. Yet the Quran tells of magicians in Pharaoh's service who were changed in one moment, and their word was: we hope our Lord will forgive us. They did not say it was too late. The second passage tells Muhammad that his Lord has not left him. So the question is less how much has passed than what can begin now.

A question for you

What is the smallest good thing that could happen today?

If you sayA word to someone I love.
ThenNothing is small on a scale where not an atom's weight is lost.
If you sayA short prayer.
ThenIt needs no form. It can be one sentence in your own language.
If you sayI do not know yet.
ThenThat is all right. Having read this far is something.

The same in the other books

Translation

Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions. Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.

חָנֵּ֣נִי אֱלֹהִ֣ים כְּחַסְדֶּ֑ךָ כְּרֹ֥ב רַ֝חֲמֶ֗יךָ מְחֵ֣ה פְשָׁעָֽי׃ הֶ֭רֶב כַּבְּסֵ֣נִי מֵעֲוֺנִ֑י וּֽמֵחַטָּאתִ֥י טַהֲרֵֽנִי׃

Cast away from you all your transgressions in which you have transgressed; and make yourself a new heart and a new spirit. For why will you die, house of Israel?

לָכֵן֩ אִ֨ישׁ כִּדְרָכָ֜יו אֶשְׁפֹּ֤ט אֶתְכֶם֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה שׁ֤וּבוּ וְהָשִׁ֨יבוּ֙ מִכָּל־פִּשְׁעֵיכֶ֔ם וְלֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֛ם לְמִכְשׁ֖וֹל עָוֺֽן׃ הַשְׁלִ֣יכוּ מֵעֲלֵיכֶ֗ם אֶת־כָּל־פִּשְׁעֵיכֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר פְּשַׁעְתֶּ֣ם בָּ֔ם וַעֲשׂ֥וּ לָכֶ֛ם לֵ֥ב חָדָ֖שׁ וְר֣וּחַ חֲדָשָׁ֑ה וְלָ֥מָּה תָמֻ֖תוּ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

Ezekiel · 18:30-31

Even so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner repenting.”
